after.description: Continuation cursor. Normally identifies the last returned instance. When scanLimitReached is true, identifies the last scanned instance, even if no rows matched. Continue with the same filters until after is absent.

scanLimitReached.description: The request exhausted its 1,000-candidate scan budget before confirming whether more matches exist. Data may be empty or shorter than the requested limit. Use after to continue; the following page may be empty if the catalog ended at the scan boundary.
